## Concepts I struggled with

| Lesson | Note | Date | Resolved |
|---|---|---|---|
| FM.02 Angles, degrees and radians | wrapping: a full circle is 2*pi rad (not 2); subtract/add 2*pi until in (-pi, pi] | 2026-09-25 | 2026-09-25 |
| FM.02 Angles, degrees and radians | averaging angles: need both cos and sin (unit arrows) then atan2(y, x) | 2026-09-25 | 2026-09-25 |
| FM.02 Angles, degrees and radians | omega is a rate (rad/s), so the clamp is a speed limit, not a target angle | 2026-09-25 | 2026-09-25 |
| FM.01 Algebra refresher for robotics formulas | s in the turn-in-place exercise was undefined: it is the wheel's arc distance, same role as d | 2026-09-25 | 2026-09-25 |
